name: The Star, the Hand and the Heart

meta.wiki: The Star, the Hand and the Heart (Alliance)

summary: In Ironforge, Gerrig Bonegrip offers Yagyin's Digest in exchange for three items of power. Their names are kept from listening ears and written in a note.

sections.title: An Exchange Behind Closed Lips
sections.body: Gerrig Bonegrip hears you ask for Yagyin's Digest and wonders whether you mean to begin a new chapter of the order somewhere. Gerrig decides it is not their place to ask. With an extra copy on hand, Gerrig believes those of the order should aid one another. So Gerrig asks you to bring three items of power. Their names stay unspoken in case someone is listening, and Gerrig writes them down.

sections.title: The Three Items
sections.body: Gerrig's note names the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart. Gerrig wants all three before handing over Yagyin's Digest.

sections.title: Gerrig's Verdict
sections.body: With the relics in hand, Gerrig calls you resourceful. Gerrig believes that if founding a new chapter of the order is truly your charge, you will run it well.

faq.q: Who asks for the three items?
aliases: who starts the star the hand and the heart
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip in Ironforge asks for three items and offers an extra copy of Yagyin's Digest in return.

faq.q: What three items does Gerrig Bonegrip want?
faq.answer: Gerrig Bonegrip's note names the Star of Xil'yeh, the Hand of Dagun and the Legacy Heart.

faq.q: Why does Gerrig write the items down instead of saying them?
faq.answer: Gerrig writes the names down because someone may be listening.

faq.q: What came before this in the chain?
faq.answer: It follows To Ironforge for Yagyin's Digest, where Theldurin the Lost sent you to Gerrig.
